title: Greer's groups call up lights on a nearby Florida beach
place_text: Beach about 40 minutes south of Cocoa Beach, Florida

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO researcher who leads groups that try to make contact with craft, takes his groups to a beach about 40 minutes south of Cocoa Beach, Florida, to call up lights in the sky. Charles Buhler, an engineer presented on the show as a NASA scientist, says this, and notes it is almost the same beach where he himself has seen things. He tells it to suggest the spot is one where such lights keep turning up.
